stem: What is one qualification that must be fulfilled for a person to become a U.S. citizen?

options.label: A
options.text: Earning an income above the national average

options.label: B
options.text: Earning an advanced degree from an American university

options.label: C
options.text: Demonstrating an understanding of the principles of American government

options.label: D
options.text: Demonstrating an understanding of the constitutions of each state
